explication: AppFlowy is a cross-platform AI workspace combining documents, databases, folders, file storage, collaboration, and AI. The principal workflow is: a user operates the Flutter client, requests cross the Rust FFI into core services, workspace content is opened or edited, domain managers update collaborative/local state, and optional cloud or AI services produce synchronized content or responses. Sampled code strongly supports storage uploads, workspace routing, database filtering/grouping, authentication, document persistence, and local/cloud AI; some Flutter UI wiring is not sampled.
